researchTopics.topic: CoA class, spec, talent and spell recovery
researchTopics.known: 21 custom classes; historical 69–70 spec counts vary by snapshot; 155 talent trees, 8610 cells, 9656 spell IDs and 217 naming discrepancies reported in earlier research
researchTopics.caveat: Historical and current Conquest Reborn identifiers may differ; counts reflect research snapshots, not fresh live verification

researchTopics.known: 70 defaultWeights scoring profiles; historical 70,838 item records and 37,557 planner variants reported; all-phase BiS completeness unverified
researchTopics.caveat: Weights are scoring inputs, not guaranteed priority lists; preserve provenance and avoid presenting inferred BiS as verified

researchTopics.known: Historical rankings, reports, builds and boss statistics sources identified
researchTopics.caveat: Do not claim complete logs archive; honor API access, attribution and redistribution restrictions

researchTopics.topic: Preservation changelogs and historical client data
researchTopics.known: Prior audit referenced 70,437 changelog entries and 7.47M client-data rows; large third-party datasets referenced rather than wholly mirrored
researchTopics.caveat: Manifest/URL is not a full backup of underlying dataset

researchTopics.known: Zul'Gurub unified 72-source pack committed; Molten Core, AQ20, dungeon mechanics, Mythic+ and boss schedules archived in separate research commits
researchTopics.caveat: Some source is reconstructed and not gameplay-tested

researchTopics.known: Upstream world manifest describes 318 tables and 3,593,783 declared rows, plus select October SQL migrations
researchTopics.caveat: Manifest is not complete SQL database export

researchTopics.known: Questie-X, LootCollector, DBM-CoA, MRT-CoA, Details and other addon projects have separate repositories
researchTopics.caveat: This research repo does not automatically contain full addon release ZIPs or chat attachments

openBackupGaps: Uploaded archives from other chats may not exist in GitHub; do not claim they are backed up
Large external datasets may be referenced but not mirrored
Historical logs and exact phase-by-phase BiS are not comprehensively retrieved
Some listed addon repositories are empty or tiny, so independently verify release sources
No direct access to all chat attachments or every conversation artifact for bulk commit
scope: Research and metadata only; no addon source changes, no proprietary third-party files.
